An '''alien species''' constructed a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nentan]]. By the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the city was a [[Ancient ruins (Nentan)|ruin]] in the [[Nentan wastes]] and no one knew anything about the original builders.
